name: Cleanup 10eLotto old runs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm:
        description: "Confermo di voler eliminare tutte le run COMPLETATE di sniper.yml"
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  cleanup:
    if: ${{ inputs.confirm == true }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Elimina tutte le run completate di sniper.yml
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Repository: $REPO"
          echo "Cerco tutte le run completate di sniper.yml..."

          RUN_IDS=$(gh api --paginate             -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"             "/repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/sniper.yml/runs?status=completed&per_page=100"             --jq '.workflow_runs[].id')

          if [ -z "$RUN_IDS" ]; then
            echo "Nessuna run completata da eliminare."
            exit 0
          fi

          COUNT=0

          for RUN_ID in $RUN_IDS; do
            echo "Elimino run ID: $RUN_ID"
            gh api               --method DELETE               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"               "/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID"
            COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
          done

          echo "Pulizia terminata. Run eliminate: $COUNT"
